raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation


`Engine.release_memory_occupation` / `resume_memory_occupation` take `tags: Optional[List[str]]`, and the HTTP routes
(`/release_memory_occupation`, `/resume_memory_occupation`, `ReleaseMemoryOccupationReqInput.tags`) accept them. The
`EngineBase` abstract methods and `HttpServerEngineAdapter` do not: their signatures are `(self)`, so a caller that
holds an adapter cannot do the staged release/resume that colocated RL needs (for example free `kv_cache` first,
then `weights`, and resume in the reverse order). `adapter.release_memory_occupation(tags=["kv_cache"])` raises
`TypeError`.

The adapter also has no wrapper for `/pause_generation` and `/continue_generation`, although it already wraps the other
RL control routes (`begin_weight_update`, `end_weight_update`, `update_weights_from_tensor`, `flush_cache`). Those two
calls are server-only by design (see the `PauseGenerationReqInput` docstring), so they are added to the adapter only,
not to `Engine` or `EngineBase`.

I checked open and closed PRs/issues for `HttpServerEngineAdapter`, `EngineBase`, `http_server_engine` and
`ReleaseMemoryOccupationReqInput tags`; none covers this. #40720 (open) also edits `http_server_engine.py`, in
`update_weights_from_tensor` only, so the hunks do not overlap.

## Modifications


- `EngineBase.release_memory_occupation` / `resume_memory_occupation`: add `tags: Optional[List[str]] = None`
  (matches `Engine`).
- `HttpServerEngineAdapter`:
  - `release_memory_occupation(tags=None)` / `resume_memory_occupation(tags=None)` send `{"tags": tags}`.
    `tags=None` keeps the old meaning (everything).
  - New `pause_generation(mode="abort")` and `continue_generation(torch_empty_cache=True)`, thin wrappers over the
    existing routes.
- New CPU unit test `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_http_server_engine_adapter.py` (mocks `requests.post`;
  checks endpoint and payload, the default, and that the `release/resume` signatures of `EngineBase` and the adapter
  equal `Engine`'s).

About 25 lines of source and 70 lines of test, no behavior change for existing callers.

## Accuracy Tests


Environment: RTX 4090 24 GB, `lmsysorg/sglang:latest` (0.5.22, commit baa9bef), Qwen3-0.6B,
`enable_memory_saver=True`, `enable_weights_cpu_backup=True`. The patch was applied to a copy of the image's
files and bind-mounted read-only over the originals; the image itself is untouched. The patch applies cleanly to
the 0.5.22 files and was written against `main` as of 2026-11-02. GPU was idle before and after the run (0% util,
15 MiB).

Before the patch (same image): `inspect.signature(HttpServerEngineAdapter.release_memory_occupation)` is `(self)`,
and `hasattr(HttpServerEngineAdapter, "pause_generation")` is `False`.

1. Unit test: `pytest test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_http_server_engine_adapter.py` -> 4 passed.
2. End-to-end against a real server launched by the adapter (GPU memory from `nvidia-smi`, MiB):

   | step | used |
   |---|---|
   | server up | 13922 |
   | `release_memory_occupation(tags=["kv_cache"])` | 2960 |
   | then `tags=["weights"]` | 1770 |
   | `resume_memory_occupation(tags=["weights"])` | 2984 |
   | then `tags=["kv_cache"]` | 13946 |

   Greedy output after the staged cycle equals the output before it. An untagged `release_memory_occupation()` /
   `resume_memory_occupation()` cycle still releases everything (1770 MiB) and the output is again identical.
3. `pause_generation(mode="in_place")` during a 1500-token generation: the request does not finish within 3 s
   while paused, and after `continue_generation()` it completes with `finish_reason=length`, 1500 tokens.
   `pause_generation(mode="abort")` ends the running request with `finish_reason=abort`.

Not tested: multi-GPU/TP > 1, `--api-key` setups (the adapter's `_make_request` sends no auth header; unchanged here),
other hardware backends.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A (no change to the inference path).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit) (isort, ruff, ruff-format, codespell on the changed files).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -0,0 +1,69 @@
+"""HttpServerEngineAdapter must expose the RL control calls the HTTP server offers."""
+
+import inspect
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints import http_server_engine
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.engine import Engine
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.EngineBase import EngineBase
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server_engine import HttpServerEngineAdapter
+
+
+def _adapter():
+    # skip __init__: it would launch a server
+    adapter = object.__new__(HttpServerEngineAdapter)
+    adapter.server_args = SimpleNamespace(url=lambda: "http://host:1")
+    return adapter
+
+
+class TestHttpServerEngineAdapterControlCalls(CustomTestCase):
+    def _call(self, method, *args, **kwargs):
+        response = mock.Mock()
+        response.json.return_value = {}
+        with (
+            mock.patch.object(
+                http_server_engine.requests, "post", return_value=response
+            ) as post,
+            mock.patch.object(http_server_engine, "ssl_verify_of", return_value=True),
+        ):
+            getattr(_adapter(), method)(*args, **kwargs)
+        return post.call_args
+
+    def test_release_resume_forward_tags(self):
+        for method in ("release_memory_occupation", "resume_memory_occupation"):
+            call = self._call(method, tags=["kv_cache"])
+            self.assertEqual(call.args[0], f"http://host:1/{method}")
+            self.assertEqual(call.kwargs["json"], {"tags": ["kv_cache"]})
+
+    def test_release_resume_default_is_all(self):
+        for method in ("release_memory_occupation", "resume_memory_occupation"):
+            self.assertEqual(self._call(method).kwargs["json"], {"tags": None})
+
+    def test_pause_continue(self):
+        call = self._call("pause_generation", mode="in_place")
+        self.assertEqual(call.args[0], "http://host:1/pause_generation")
+        self.assertEqual(call.kwargs["json"], {"mode": "in_place"})
+        call = self._call("continue_generation", torch_empty_cache=False)
+        self.assertEqual(call.args[0], "http://host:1/continue_generation")
+        self.assertEqual(call.kwargs["json"], {"torch_empty_cache": False})
+
+    def test_signatures_match_engine(self):
+        # the adapter and EngineBase must accept whatever Engine accepts
+        for name in ("release_memory_occupation", "resume_memory_occupation"):
+            expected = list(inspect.signature(getattr(Engine, name)).parameters)
+            for cls in (EngineBase, HttpServerEngineAdapter):
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    list(inspect.signature(getattr(cls, name)).parameters), expected
+                )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
